name: Nicotinamide riboside
summary: Nicotinamide riboside carries an editorial Grade B rating, but the studies recorded on this profile do not demonstrate that grade. Recorded activity centres on SIRT1 signaling and SIRT1, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. Mild GI upset, headache, or flushing possible; long-term clinical outcome safety is still limited.
